thread:
ashley: Quick flag  PR #612 added a troubleshooting section about 429s and context trimming but has a few SDK examples that are stale. Can someone scrub?
jia: Point me to examples please. I can patch and add a short migration note.
ashley: Top snippet uses `client.send({max_concurrency: 8})` which should be `concurrency_limit` in SDK 0.9. Also we mention `429_retry: true` as a config flag; runtime now handles retries via fallbacks.
sam: I'll open a tiny PR to update function names and add a migration table (old -> new).
mike: Add a note about batching vs p99: larger batch_window reduces cost but can spike p99 under heavy tail; put an example explaining tuning.
jia: Here's the compact diff I plan to land:
```diff
- client.send({max_concurrency: 8})
+ client.send({concurrency_limit: 8})
```
olivia: Can we include a mini integration test in examples/ that runs the snippet against a local mock? Helps CI catch regressions.
ashley: Yes. @doc-bot attach a docs-qa checklist to PR: samples-lint, links-check, migration-note, example-ci.
doc-bot: checklist added to PR #612: samples-lint, links-check, migration-note, example-ci
sam: I'll take samples-lint and example CI wiring. jia, can you draft the migration copy and a short "If you see more 429s after upgrading" list?
jia: Will do. Plan: three fixes — tune concurrency_limit, enable prefix/KV caching, and add exponential backoff with jitter. Add a staging repro command: `hey -n 500 -c 40 https://staging.api.redwood/v1/generate`.
mike: +1 on repro command and region note.
ashley: Timeline: land by Fri EOD, quick review slot in Friday docs sync. After merge, backport migration note to older troubleshooting doc.
doc-bot: backport issue queued post-merge. :white_check_mark:
